prompt:
You are the communication step of RiceBridge Ops, an irrigation agent for a 6-field rice cluster that shares one pump station in An Giang.

Deterministic tools have ALREADY computed the plan (water balance, crop-stage safety, pump capacity). You must not change any action, order, date or number. Your job:
1. headline_en / headline_vi: one sentence each that tells the pump-station manager what the plan does and the single most important reason, combining the events in INPUT.recent_events.
2. explain_en: 2-3 plain-English sentences for a non-expert audience on why the order is what it is (use the reasons given).
3. messages: one chat message per field in INPUT.rows (same fid), short (max 2 sentences), polite southern Vietnamese (anh/chị, nhé), plus English. Say clearly whether to open the inlet (and when HTX calls) or keep it closed and wait. For F3 (Bà Sáu, no smartphone) write the message to the HTX officer asking him to tell bà Sáu. If a row has measure_first true, ask HTX to measure that field before opening the inlet.

Hard constraint: every number you write must appear in INPUT (levels, dates, field numbers, mm). Do not invent yields, money, emissions or percentages.

Reply with ONE JSON object only, no prose, no code fence. It must match this JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "required": ["headline_en", "headline_vi", "explain_en", "messages"], "properties": {"headline_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "headline_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "explain_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 600}, "messages": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["fid", "text_vi", "text_en"], "properties": {"fid": {"type": "string", "enum": ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]}, "text_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 260}, "text_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 300}}}}}}

data.headline_en: The Fri 06 Mar pump run opens F4 first, then F6, because both need standing water by Sat 07 Mar; F1, F2, F3 and F5 wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.
data.headline_vi: Lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar mở cống F4 trước, rồi F6, vì cả hai cần có nước đứng trước Sat 07 Mar; F1, F2, F3 và F5 chờ đợt sau Tue 10 Mar.
data.explain_en: F4 goes first because it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar without standing water and its fast-draining soil (4.4 mm/day) has already lost its water, so HTX should measure it before opening the inlet. F6 is second because its top-dressing window on Sat 07 Mar also needs standing water. The other four fields were re-flooded and can wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 4 ơi, F4 được mở cống đầu tiên trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé. HTX sẽ đo mực nước ruộng trước khi mở cống vì lần đo gần nhất đã 6 ngày rồi.
messages.text_en: F4 owner: your field is first in the Fri 06 Mar pump run. HTX will measure the water level before opening the inlet, since the last reading is 6 days old.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 6 ơi, F6 được mở cống thứ hai trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar, ngay sau F4 nhé. Ruộng cần có nước đứng cho đợt bón thúc Sat 07 Mar.
messages.text_en: F6 owner: your field is second in the Fri 06 Mar pump run, right after F4. It needs standing water for the top-dressing on Sat 07 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 1 ơi, F1 còn nước, cứ giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm sau Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: F1 owner: your field still has water, so keep the inlet closed and wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 2 ơi, F2 còn nước, cứ giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm sau Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: F2 owner: your field still has water, so keep the inlet closed and wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh cán bộ HTX ơi, nhờ anh báo giúp bà Sáu là F3 còn nước, cứ giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm sau Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: HTX officer: please tell Bà Sáu that F3 still has water, so she should keep the inlet closed and wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.
